recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞密度高，箭頭指出的巨核細胞體積小、只有單一圓形或低分葉的核，屬於異常增生的小型／低分葉巨核細胞（micromegakaryocytes / hypolobated megakaryocytes），背景有紅系與顆粒球前驅細胞，是 MDS 巨核細胞異型性的線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage precursors between fat spaces
Arrowed small megakaryocytes with a single round or hypolobated nucleus and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Numerous erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors and occasional larger immature cells with nucleoli
No obvious clusters of blasts at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. The arrows highlight small megakaryocytes with single round or hypolobated nuclei and modest eosinophilic cytoplasm, consistent with dysplastic micromegakaryocytes. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors are abundant, with occasional larger immature cells but no obvious blast clusters at this power. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myelodysplastic neoplasm; confirmation of multilineage dysplasia on the aspirate, blast enumeration (CD34 staining) and cytogenetics are recommended.

ddx.vs: del(5q) megakaryocytes are normal-sized to small with round monolobated nuclei, and distinction requires karyotype.
CML dwarf megakaryocytes occur with marked granulocytic hyperplasia and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but retain normal size and lobation.
